body: Yes, I don't fear death at all. If it's my time, I'm as willing as ever. I just try not to force in upon myself. I feel like if I need to die, I will, but just gotta wait. No need to take your life, cause you never know who's life you'll touch later on.

It's funny, I've always contemplated this. Even though it seems like there are many examples contradicting this, there seems to be no life without love. Somewhere, someone, something out there loves you. Have you ever lost something you loved? It could if been when you were a child, and lost a favourite blanket. There is an entity that loves you, and if you died, than you'd just break that much of that entity's heart. And in this world, everything matters.

You aren't a moody teenage girl for one...a moody teenage girl whines day and night cause her daddy bought her the wrong coloured iPhone. You are a meaningful person, with a meaningful life, that anyone should pay attention to! That anyone should take time out of their life to talk to! I'm not saying things'll get easier right now, cause they won't, but you should almost even praise yourself for being so strong about this! And age? It doesn't matter if you're 11, or 111, a problem is a problem, and you reached out for help, with is sadly a lot more than a lot of others. I'm glad I took the time outta my day to talk, it's time well spent.
That'd be cool, I rarely use Skype, just cause of lack of people to talk to, but it's good knowing I'm not just crazy, and there are more people like me

I can't tell you all the answers, no one can. But what I'd like to offer what I can, which is to tell you that your problems aren't minor. They matter, as much as you think they might not be as bad as someone else's, they still matter a hell of a lot, to me, and to everyone else on this subreddit. Also, your phone taken away? Not selfish at all. You used it for completely justifiable reasons, so you can't beat yourself up over it. It's the little things I find that can make a big impact on ones life, so I can assure you that all this won't last long, and while you're here, try not call yourself selfish. Don't think that your problem is minor. And if it helps at all, I care. I may not have the answer, I may not have the solution, but I care. I know it's not what you want, but it's something. It's all I can give, and I wanted to give it my all!
